The final forecast probabilities range from 22% (focused on legal/evidentiary hurdles and institutional resistance) to 42% (focused on aggressive patterns of politicized indictments and the pressure of impending deadlines), with most experts clustering around 32-38%. The modal scenario for a 'No' outcome is DOJ inability or reluctance to substantiate charges, resistance from prosecutors or judges, and lack of legal justification. The modal 'Yes' scenario is a last-minute, politically-motivated indictment with a weak legal basis, filed to fulfill presidential demands and as part of a broader pattern of retributive justice. In summary, all forecasters view indictments as much more likely than under any previous administration, but still less likely than not before January 1, 2026.
